mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear and it is 60 degrees near Verona City Hall. Looking up at 8:30 PM, you will be able to spot the International Space Station as it passes from the Northwest near Verona High School towards the East for three minutes. The overnight low will be 48 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona has announced a free E-Waste drop-off event this October 17 at the Recycling Center on Investment Court for residents with proof of address. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is actively recruiting new patrol officers, welcoming both those new to the field and experienced lateral transfers to join their community-oriented team.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Also, mark your calendars for the award-winning Verona Fall Fest happening this September 25 at Hometown USA Festival Park.

Reviewing the weekly report, on September 5, an officer encountered a unique situation where multiple vehicles had cheese slices placed on their windshields due to a viral social media prank, though fortunately, no damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed as they undergo a scheduled remodel of the store.
